decisions.reason: As a core garage-door-operator line that completes the firm's one-stop system offering, it has likely proven its value by now and is cheap to retain relative to its strategic upside.

After several years, this lightly differentiated remote-control operator no longer offers much option value as a separate product and is more efficiently absorbed into or replaced by the broader operator range.

With the other glazed industrial door variants already withdrawn, this surviving model likely fills a clear industrial niche in the firm's portfolio and still supports its customized compliant solutions strategy.
